seoTitle: Finding a DAAD Scholarship: Choose the Right Scheme for Your Degree
title: Finding a DAAD Scholarship: Choose the Right Scheme for Your Degree
content:
DAAD scholarships are a collection of schemes with different purposes and eligibility rules. Choose the relevant scheme first, then check its academic requirements, application route and coverage.

Choose the relevant scholarship scheme

Search the DAAD scholarship database using your academic level, country and subject. Read the individual announcement in full. Some schemes support a complete degree; others fund research visits or other activities. Requirements and application routes can differ considerably.

Check eligibility and coverage

Confirm academic qualifications, relevant experience where required, language evidence and the permitted timing of your previous degree. Read the listed funding period and allowances, then check whether tuition or other charges remain your responsibility. Avoid assuming one scheme provides the same benefits as another.

Coordinate the applications

A scholarship application and university admission may require separate submissions. Record both deadlines, identify the correct recipient for each document and allow time for references. Use the scheme announcement as the final checklist and ask the named contact about a specific ambiguity before submitting.

Official information

  • DAAD scholarship database

Read one scholarship announcement in full

Before collecting documents, identify the scheme that matches your academic level and purpose. Note the eligible countries, degree timing, language evidence and professional experience requirements where relevant. Write down whether applications go to DAAD, the university or another body. Check benefits separately rather than assuming the word “scholarship” covers every cost. If the announcement leaves an important detail unclear, contact the named office with a precise question. Keep its answer beside the scheme instructions, and check whether you also need a separate admission application.

Relevant listings and guides on NextApply

To see how these questions apply to a real listing, review DAAD EPOS Scholarship 2027/28 - Fully Funded Development-Related Postgraduate Courses in Germany. Compare its stated requirements with your own preparation and check the official source before applying.

You can also browse German Academic Exchange Service on NextApply and the scholarships category. Listings and recruitment windows can change.

For the next part of your preparation, read Studying in Germany: Tuition Fees, Living Costs and Funding, University Motivation Letter: Explain Your Preparation and Course Choice.
